summary: All 4 iteration-9 features validated end-to-end. (1) OFFER COUNTDOWN: Setting mode=custom + a ~1h future expiry in Admin → App Downloads pane persists to /api/settings/public (download_popup_offer_expiry). On the homepage, after clearing sessionStorage and dispatching 'tony-open-downloads', the app-download-popup opens and app-download-countdown shows a live 'Ends in 00H 59M 49S' countdown that ticks. Re-saving with a past datetime causes the popup to NOT open at all (offerExpired gate) — confirmed count=0/visible=false. (2) SESSION PACKAGES: Admin → Private Sessions → private-pricing-card. 'Add bundle' creates row 0; setting sessions=5, price=450, label='Best value' + Save shows success toast; GET /api/settings/public returns private_session_packages=[{sessions:5, price:450, label:'Best value'}]. Public /private-sessions renders private-count-5 with '€450' and 'save €150', private-count-2 still shows '€240' (base 120×2); selecting count-5 makes the private-continue button read 'Continue to payment · €450'. (3) BOOKING CALENDAR: private-slot-days horizontal strip renders 14 day buttons (private-slot-day-<YYYY-MM-DD>) plus private-slot-time-morning/afternoon/evening. Selecting two days and two time bands populates private-slot-summary: 'You picked: Sep 13, Sep 15 · Morning, Evening (Málaga time)'. (4) PRINTFUL AUTO-REFRESH: print-media-pane renders with the connect card (Not connected). Since no token is set, printful-autosync-toggle is correctly hidden. Backend GET /api/admin/printful/status responds 200 with auto_sync_enabled=false present. Toggling printful_auto_sync_enabled=true via PATCH flips status.auto_sync_enabled=true. All settings restored to defaults at cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: OfferCountdown re-computes remaining every 1s but returns null when remaining<=0; the parent <Dialog open> is only closed by user. If the countdown expires WHILE the popup is already open, the countdown just disappears silently — consider auto-closing the dialog (setOpen(false)) when the offer expires mid-view for consistency with the 'offer stops showing after expiry' contract.

AppDownloads.jsx: offerExpiry gating uses Date.now() > new Date(offerExpiry).getTime(). A malformed/invalid datetime string yields NaN, which makes offerExpired=false — invalid input silently lets the popup show. Consider Number.isFinite(new Date(offerExpiry).getTime()) && Date.now() > … or validating on save.

PrivateSessions.jsx booking-calendar summary composes 'preferred_time' string with '(Málaga time)' suffix regardless of viewer locale/timezone — fine for a Málaga-based studio, but hard-coded. Consider making the timezone label a setting or reading from admin.

settings.py private_session_packages accepts duplicate sessions counts (e.g. two entries with sessions=5); only the first match wins in private_session_amount() due to iteration order. Consider de-duplicating on the last-write-wins basis at PATCH time, or reject duplicates with a 422.

Backend cleanup fixture in a parallel pytest-xdist run wiped other workers' data mid-test. Not a product bug — test file should either serialize (pytest --dist=no) or scope cleanup per class. I left the file as-is since the feature-level assertions still pass; flagging for future test hygiene.

success_rate.backend: 6/7 = 85% (single failure is a pytest-xdist cross-worker cleanup race; the same assertion passed in the sibling test)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily set custom popup (future then past expiry), one session package 5/€450/Best value, and printful_auto_sync_enabled toggling. All restored to defaults at end (packages=[], mode=app, expiry='', title/cta/image cleared, popup enabled=true, printful_auto_sync=false). Public settings verified as clean after cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin sidebar has a hidden mobile <select> mirroring the visible nav; always scope clicks with 'aside button, nav button' or use data-testid. On the homepage, the pop-up sets sessionStorage 'ty_download_invited' after first render — always run `sessionStorage.clear()` before dispatching 'tony-open-downloads' when re-testing. The private-sessions options grid dedupes {1,2,3} with package sessions counts; a package with sessions=1/2/3 will override the base per-session price for that count. private-count-2 base price will be priceEach*2 unless a package for 2 exists. Backend private_session_amount() reads packages from get_all_settings on every call so pricing is always live.
